body.statement: For fixed \(0<\alpha<1/2\), \[R_{N,\alpha}(u)\asymp_\alpha\min\{1,u^{-1/2}\}\] uniformly over admissible \(u=u_N>0\) for which \(\mathcal M_N(u)\) is nonempty.
body.justification: One collection information index governs honest precision from weak compliance through the regular regime.
body.gap: No published result gives an all-procedure confidence-length frontier for a bounded transported CACE under union-of-trials support.
body.consumer: The allocation value becomes a planning and reporting diagnostic for multi-trial transported CACE.
